verdicts.reason: A is scattered across a broken two-column grid. The product circle is tiny and floats top-right. The CTA has shrunk to a minuscule pill sitting level with the badges, and FREE DELIVERY and SUMMER ONLY float in dead space. The body copy is stranded at the bottom right, below the badges, so reading order collapses and there is a lot of empty space. B keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order: brand, headline, product, actions. But the CTA is squeezed to the same small size as the three badges in one row, so it is buried, the body copy is left alone at the bottom after the CTA, and large empty bands sit around the button row.
